components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action. Mat hued, self-tinted shadows, halo focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.693 0.042 169.768); border: 1px solid oklch(0.693 0.042 169.768); color: oklch(0.894 0.057 89.24); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.576 0.066 199.487); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.576 0.066 199.487) 24%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.576 0.066 199.487) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.277 0 0), 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(0.765 0.158 110.835); border: 1px solid oklch(0.765 0.158 110.835); color: oklch(0.277 0 0); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.656 0.135 109.119); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.656 0.135 109.119) 24%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.656 0.135 109.119) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.277 0 0), 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.693 0.042 169.768); }

components.name: Sunken Input
components.description: An editable well: recessed fill, hairline border, monospace value, variant halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.69 0.035 76.307); } .ds-input { margin: 0; width: 220px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.482 0.018 61.042) 55%, transparent); background: oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866); color: oklch(0.894 0.057 89.24); outline: none; font: 400 14px/1.5 "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.277 0 0), 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); }

components.name: Slider
components.description: Aurora fill on a muted track, ground thumb bordered in the variant hue, self-tinted shadow.
components.css: .ds-slider { position: relative; height: 14px; } .ds-slider-track { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866); } .ds-slider-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); } .ds-slider-thumb { position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.277 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.277 0 0) 20%, transparent), 0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.277 0 0) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Toggle (on)
components.description: Filled track + 6px same-hue glow when on — the Pilot Light Rule at work.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 34px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); background: oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); box-shadow: 0 0 6px oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-toggle-knob { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 18px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.894 0.057 89.24); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.277 0 0), 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Chosen segment fills; muted variant signals through border + brighter text instead of a fill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866); } .ds-seg-opt { padding: 1px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.69 0.035 76.307); font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-seg-chosen { border-color: oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); background: oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); color: oklch(0.894 0.057 89.24); } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.277 0 0), 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A quiet container: Panel Surface, hairline border, flat at rest.
components.html: sliderCutoff sits on a muted track.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.482 0.018 61.042) 55%, transparent); background: oklch(0.344 0.007 48.523); color: oklch(0.894 0.057 89.24); } .ds-sec-label { font: 400 12px/1.5 "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.69 0.035 76.307); } .ds-body { max-width: 62ch; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Monospace outline pill; variants tint border and text only.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin-right: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.482 0.018 61.042) 55%, transparent); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.69 0.035 76.307); font: 400 12px/1.5 "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; } .ds-badge-pro { color: oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); border-color: oklch(0.471 0.082 215.806); }

components.name: Readout
components.description: The instrument display — label : monospace value in a hairline pill.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.482 0.018 61.042) 55%, transparent); background: oklch(0.344 0.007 48.523); } .ds-readout-label { font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.69 0.035 76.307); } .ds-readout-value { font: 400 14px/1.5 "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; color: oklch(0.894 0.057 89.24); }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: Signature: a glowing LED, optional mono index, uppercase title.
components.css: .ds-sec-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-led { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.489 0.124 344.276); color: oklch(0.489 0.124 344.276); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px currentColor); } .ds-index { font: 400 12px/1.25 "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; color: oklch(0.69 0.035 76.307); } .ds-sec-title { margin: 0; font: 600 18px/1.25 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.894 0.057 89.24); }

narrative.overview: The Terminal Atelier treats every interface as a workbench for making — a matte, warm-technical surface lit like a dim room where the thing being made is the only thing that should draw the eye. The ground is never black, never glossy, never corporate: it is Gruvbox-warm dark layered in quiet wells, and the UI that frames the canvas is a precise instrument rather than a dressed-up dashboard. Everything recedes by default and answers when touched. Borders are barely-there hairlines; controls sit flat and calm until a state calls for them. Luminance is a currency spent deliberately: an active slider fill, a glowing toggle, an LED dot before a heading, the aura of a focused ring. Where the interface floats above the work — a floating control panel, a menu, a handle — it turns into glass, translucent and lightly blurred, so the canvas stays present through the chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Matte, layered dark ground — never pure black, warmed by Gruvbox.
Canvas-first: surrounding UI occupies as little attention as possible.
Instrument-grade controls: tactile, confident, immediate feedback.
Luminous accents as state language — glow means active, selected, or live.
Glass + light backdrop blur reserved for floating UI above the canvas.
Hairline borders, restrained radius, tonal surfaces instead of heavy shadows.
Compact technical typography with monospace readouts.
Responsive and touch-first: no interaction depends on hover.

rules.name: The Pilot Light Rule
rules.body: Glow — actual luminosity — is a state language for active, selected, and live elements only. Idle elements stay matte; a glowing thing is a living thing.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Never pure black. Depth comes from the layered Gruvbox darks (dark0→dark4), not from subtracting light to zero.

rules.name: The Upper-Label Rule
rules.body: Titles and section labels are uppercase with wide tracking; body and field labels stay sentence-case.

rules.name: The Mono Readout Rule
rules.body: Any displayed number, identifier, or parameter value renders in monospace.

rules.name: The Shadow-Paints-Itself Rule
rules.body: Every shadow derives from a `shadowColor` variable via color-mix; an element sets its shadow color to its own background, so shadows are tinted by their carrier and never a flat black.

rules.name: The Glass-on-Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: Blur and translucency exist only on UI that floats above other content.

dos: Do keep the canvas the visual priority — scaffolding occupies minimal attention and never competes with the work.
Do spend glow on active, selected, or live state only (Pilot Light Rule).
Do use glass (translucent + blur) for floating UI and keep in-flow surfaces opaque.
Do use monospace for readings and values (Mono Readout Rule); uppercase + wide tracking for titles (Upper-Label Rule).
Do let shadows be tinted by the element that casts them.
Do show keyboard focus with the 2px-ground + 3px-ring halo, whatever the color.
Do build every control so touch works with no hover dependency.
donts: Don't feel like a SaaS dashboard — no gloss, no corporate blues-per-suite, no heavy decorations.
Don't use pure black; warm near-black Gruvbox layers are the ground (Warm Ground Rule).
Don't blur in-flow content — backdrop blur is only for floating UI (Glass-on-Floating-Only Rule).
Don't lean on big shadows; surfaces are flat by default and shadow is a response to state.
Don't reach for display-size headlines; the compact hierarchy is the system.
Don't animate decoratively or perpetually — motion is fast (120–320ms) and purposeful.
Don't hardcode raw palette values in app code; semantic tokens are the only interface to color.
